open_issues.impact: durable writes and /readyz recover once the backend speaks protocol 2 again
open_issues.text: Bug fixed on the spot (D43): persistence's protocolMismatch flag was sticky. One 409 collaboration_protocol_mismatch (for example from an old backend pod during a rollout) stopped durable writes until restart, and reportProtocolMismatch did not re-evaluate writes. Now a committed append (ledger acked) or any 2xx seen by the instrumented backend clears it (protocolCompatible), and reportProtocolMismatch re-evaluates writes at once.

open_issues.next: P5.12: implement the reactions; docs pass: document the codes
open_issues.text: Client-protocol additions P5.12 (vue-collaboration) must handle: (1) status {t:'status', mode, writes:'stopped', reason} with reason draining | pending_budget | backend_unavailable | protocol_mismatch | document_too_large; the open status is unchanged. (2) New nack codes: collaboration_update_too_large (retry:false), document_too_large (retry:false), rate_limited (retry:true). (3) Close codes: 4503 draining (reconnect, ideally to another hub, keep the queue, resend unacked envelopes); 4413 update_too_large or document_too_large (do not resend that update); 4429 rate_limited, too_many_connections or too_many_rooms (back off). onConnect/onAuthenticate refusals carry reason 'draining', 'too_many_connections' or 'too_many_rooms'.

open_issues.impact: configuration surface of the hub image
open_issues.text: Detail choices (D44, detail level). (a) Env names follow the VAULTER_COLLAB_ prefix: VAULTER_COLLAB_MANAGEMENT_HOST/PORT, _READY_BACKEND_TTL_MS (default 30000; must exceed the compaction interval), _SHUTDOWN_FLUSH_MS, _SHUTDOWN_DESTROY_MS, _MAX_UPDATE_BYTES, _MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES, _MAX_REQUEST_BYTES, _MAX_ROOMS_PER_TENANT, _MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_ROOM, _MAX_UPDATES_PER_SECOND_PER_ROOM. (b) The readiness heartbeat is any 2xx of the hub's own backend calls (no new backend ping route); without a webhook secret the lease call is refused and /readyz stays false. (c) collab_append_latency_seconds is the round trip of each append attempt. (d) collab_epoch_mismatch_total has label source=append|compaction. (e) The tenant for MAX_ROOMS_PER_TENANT is the JWT tenant claim, read unverified after the backend accepted the token; null tenant is one bucket. (f) The per-room rate is a token bucket per room for sync writes and another for envelopes; only writable connections are counted. Because the bucket is per room as specified, a flooding writer can push an innocent writer of the same room into 4429. (g) /stats is kept on the management listener for the load harness. (h) New config validations: the frame (VAULTER_COLLAB_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) must hold the largest envelope, MAX_REQUEST_BYTES must hold the largest append, and MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES must be >= MAX_UPDATE_BYTES.

open_issues.text: Grace period: flush 30 s plus destroy 5 s is 35 s, which is above Kubernetes' default terminationGracePeriodSeconds of 30 s and docker stop's default of 10 s. The hub compose file sets stop_grace_period: 40s and the Dockerfile comment says so; manifests elsewhere are not in the repo.

open_issues.impact: if one is wrong, V1/V2 go red in websocket-hardening/limits/shutdown, or a write could slip through while draining via a writer Hocuspocus does not treat as read-only
open_issues.text: Assumptions about Hocuspocus 4.3 I could not check against its dist here: server.configuration holds stopOnSignals and the hooks; server.httpServer.listening tells whether the WS listens; beforeHandleMessage receives the raw message (varString name, type, sync step…) as `update` for every message type, stateless included; setting connection.readOnly makes Hocuspocus drop a writer's sync step 2/update (relied on for draining and full rooms, as P5.7 did for stopped writes); Document.getConnections() lists a room's connections; a thrown error in onConnect/onAuthenticate refuses the connection. Also assumed: ioredis client.status === 'ready' when connected, and Y.encodeStateVectorFromUpdate/decodeStateVector exist in yjs 13.6.

For P5.10/P5.11: POST /control (HMAC) belongs on the same listener; add it to createManagement's handle (src/management.js), which answers 405 for non-GET today. collab_revoked_still_connected currently counts open connections whose token exp has passed (persistence.revokedStillConnected); P5.11 should add connections revoked by the control channel. instrumentBackend (src/management.js) wraps authenticate/load/append/leaseCompaction/publishCheckpoint; a new backend call must be added there to feed the readiness.

summary: P5.9 hub operations. New src/management.js: loopback-by-default listener (VAULTER_COLLAB_MANAGEMENT_HOST 127.0.0.1 : VAULTER_COLLAB_MANAGEMENT_PORT 1235). /livez answers from the event loop only; /readyz is 503 unless the WS server listens, the backend gave a 2xx within VAULTER_COLLAB_READY_BACKEND_TTL_MS (cached status from instrumentBackend over every hub call; the worker's lease call every interval is the heartbeat, the probe calls nothing), the protocol is compatible (409 collaboration_protocol_mismatch makes it false, any later 2xx clears it), Redis clients are ready when Redis is configured, and the hub is not draining. /metrics serves Prometheus text (src/metrics.js registry, no new deps, every collab_* metric of p5-design plus pending_bytes, appended/dropped, limit_rejections{limit}, writes_stopped, draining, ready; no room/document labels). /stats kept for the load harness. startHealthEndpoint, /health on 0.0.0.0 and healthPort/VAULTER_COLLAB_HEALTH_PORT removed. New src/shutdown.js: the one SIGTERM/SIGINT handler (Server stopOnSignals: false; no other module installs signal handlers). draining=true synchronously (readyz 503, onConnect/onAuthenticate refuse, a connection that lands meanwhile closes 4503) -> persistence.stopWrites('draining') (writers read-only, so Hocuspocus drops sync step 2/updates; envelopes nacked writes_stopped retry:true; serverWrite refused) -> ledger flush loop until empty or VAULTER_COLLAB_SHUTDOWN_FLUSH_MS 30000 (blocked records retried every 200 ms), worker.stop alongside -> closeEveryRoom 4503 draining -> destroy() raced with VAULTER_COLLAB_SHUTDOWN_DESTROY_MS 5000 -> unflushed counted after destroy -> log.error(message, {unflushed, documents, rooms}) and exit 1, else exit 0; cancellable timers; a repeated signal is ignored; a failing step is logged and does not stop the drain. New src/limits.js (imports nothing): MAX_UPDATE_BYTES 1 MiB, MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES 16 MiB, MAX_REQUEST_BYTES 2 MiB, MAX_ROOMS_PER_TENANT 1000, MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_ROOM 100, MAX_UPDATES_PER_SECOND_PER_ROOM 200 (VAULTER_COLLAB_* env, validated). Sizes come from lengths or headers before decoding. A raw message over its size closes 4413 in beforeHandleMessage; an oversized stateless payload is nacked before JSON.parse; an envelope is nacked collaboration_update_too_large from its base64 length before decoding. A per-room token bucket per channel: sync writes close 4429, envelopes nack rate_limited retry:true. Connections per room are checked at onConnect and registered at connected (a concurrent overshoot closes 4429); rooms per tenant use the token's tenant claim after the backend accepted it. A backend body over the limit is never sent and answers a local 413 collaboration_update_too_large (checkpoint gets base64 of MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES on top). Document size: estimate plus Y.encodeStateAsUpdate measure at most once per 64 KiB of growth; a full room mutes its writers (status writes:stopped reason document_too_large) and nacks document_too_large unless the room already holds the update (state-vector check), so a sync-first update is still appended. persistence.js: stopWrites, per-room stop reasons in status, protocolCompatible (fix: protocolMismatch was sticky), revokedStillConnected, isWriteMessage moved to limits.js and re-exported. backend.js: authenticate returns status; request-size gate. index.js: hooks onConnect/onAuthenticate/connected/beforeHandleMessage/onDisconnect wire draining and limits; boot() builds the instrumented backend, readiness, metrics, management and coordinator (installed before listen). Dockerfile: HEALTHCHECK -> /livez on the management port, MANAGEMENT_HOST=127.0.0.1, EXPOSE 1234 only, STOPSIGNAL SIGTERM. Hub docker-compose: management env, management port not published (commented loopback option), stop_grace_period 40s, healthcheck /livez. Tests: new test/{management,shutdown,limits,metrics}.test.js; security/webhook/websocket-hardening adjusted; tests/baseline rewritten with `scripts/t baseline --write -p hub` (hub 22 -> 26). Other commands run: npm run check (exit 0); node --test retry/ledger/webhook/v1-paths/config/security/management/metrics (100 pass, exit 0); `scripts/t baseline --compare -p core,media,drive,webhooks,documents,collaboration,azgard,filament,repo,hub` (exit 0); under throwaway yjs/hocuspocus/tiptap/ws stubs loaded with `node --import $TMPDIR/p59-stubs/register.mjs` (not committed): limits+shutdown 31/31 pass, modes/envelope/readonly/collab-expiry/epoch-fence/on-connect 50/50 pass, the new websocket-hardening P5.9 case passes.
